title: Ten years at the Club Plantation, 1934-44
summary: They recall that a four-week booking became ten years, and that the club moved to a new location in summer 1940.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: We were back in the Club.
Back in the Club. See, we stayed at the Club for ten years. So it was just one of those things, we went in and out and back in and out. And then we went in for four weeks. That's originally.
You went in for four weeks and we stayed there ten years.
Ten years, that's right. Ten years. We came out -- we went in in '34 and came out in '44. And went back to the Club in '40. You know what happened in '40? They moved the new Club --
They moved the new Club before we went up there in 44. They did that in the summer of '40.
See, because we left -- we closed in the summer of '40, we went to Kansas City.
